page.layout: One printed page, left part of a two-column index on the scan; the right side is cut off. Running text: a heading "INDEX" at the top, then the entries of the letter S in one column, with page numbers at the right edge of each line. A woodcut ornament at the lower right.; One column of index entries on the right, with a running head "DE X" at the top; a decorative woodcut at lower left (not text).
page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so many entries end mid-line. Several words are uncertain, e.g. "Salii" and "prisicorum". The first line is partly lost at the right edge. The top heading reads "INDEX" only in part ("I N" visible). The Greek entry "Τριχοχαρακτη" is uncertain and copied from a blurred print; the woodcut at lower left is an ornament, not transcribed. The entry "Uti literis, id est, scribere" has its last word read as "scribero" and the page number as "10"; both are doubtful.
